messages:
Asha (Billing): Heads up — Acme (acct: acme-corp) flagged an issue: mid-cycle downgrade didn't result in the expected partial credit being applied. Invoice INV-2024-0453 still shows full amount due but we generated a credit note instead of offsetting the invoice. PO on file: PO-8773 (they require a credit note).
Marta (Support): Which change triggered it? Downgrade date and expected proration amount?
Asha (Billing): Downgrade executed 2024-06-05. Proration calculated: $1,234.56 USD. System created a standalone credit note (CN-2024-078) because account has PO flag. But invoice balance wasn't reduced — customer says AP needs invoice with credit applied to reconcile.
Diego (Finance Ops): Quick check: accounts with PO often have flag require_separate_credit_notes=true. Our current flow creates a credit note but doesn't auto-apply it to invoices for audit/PO matching reasons. Is the ask to both provide the CN PDF and reduce outstanding balance?
Marta (Support): Exactly — procurement needs the CN PDF to attach to the PO, and the finance team needs the outstanding balance reduced so next payment amount is lower. Right now INV-2024-0453 still shows $10,000 due.
Liam (Eng): Reproduced in staging: downgrade -> billing-service emits event with apply_to_invoice=false because account.flags.separate_credit_notes==true. Minimal example payload from staging:```json
{"account_id":"acme-corp","change":"downgrade","proration_cents":123456,"currency":"USD","apply_to_invoice":false,"credit_note_id":"CN-2024-STG-001"}```
Diego (Finance Ops): So behavior matches config — not a calculation bug but a UX/ops gap. Historically we issue standalone CNs for PO accounts; teams then manually apply them if customer wants balance adjusted. We should have a support playbook for this.
Asha (Billing): I did a manual apply while on the call: Support console -> Billing -> Credits -> open CN-2024-078 -> Apply to invoice -> choose INV-2024-0453 -> confirm. Outcome: invoice balance reduced by $1,234.56 and ledger entry LDG-99021 created. CN now references the invoice in notes.
Marta (Support): Perfect — customer confirmed AP can close the PO with the CN attached. Can we provide the CN PDF and the ledger reference?
Diego (Finance Ops): Yes — CN PDF exported and attached to the customer case. Ledger entry: LDG-99021. Comment added: "applied by Asha (Billing) 2024-06-10" for audit.
Liam (Eng): I'll open a small work item to reduce future friction: add a feature-flagged option to auto-apply credits for PO accounts when customer preference is set (PR #2345). Also add an alert when a credit is created but not applied for >72h.
Asha (Billing): Also request: update customer-facing email template to include CN number + instructions on how the credit affects next invoice. I'll draft the copy.
BillingBot: Credit note CN-2024-078 created for acme-corp; status: applied; ledger entries: LDG-99021.
SupportBot: :white_check_mark: Case update: CN PDF attached and sent to customer. Marking as resolved pending customer acknowledgement.
Marta (Support): I'll send the PDF, close the support ticket, and create follow-up FIN-1029 to update docs + add the 72h alert.
Diego (Finance Ops): Assign FIN-1029 to Finance Ops + Eng (Liam). Thanks all.
Asha (Billing): Thanks team — customer ops happy. We'll monitor similar PO accounts for the next week to catch any repeats.
